verdict.rationale: Radar rules, value lists, and targeted transaction-review lists let a rule or list apply automatically across many transactions/customers at once (stripe-radar-docs-1,2,3,10,11,14), which is a form of bulk automation, but the documented Review API only exposes per-item actions (POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve) with no bulk/batch endpoint or explicit multi-item API call shown. missing for 10: evidence of a bulk API endpoint for approving/declining multiple reviews or disputes at once, and any AI-native tooling for programmatic multi-item operations.
